title: Bomba, plena, salsa and reggaeton
goal: Describe four Puerto Rican music styles and grant a point formally with *si bien*.
grammar: formal concessive clauses with si bien, applied to Puerto Rican music

items: I can grant a true point and then give the main idea with *si bien*.
I can say where and when bomba, plena, salsa and reggaeton began.
I can use the new words for barrel drums, hand drums and record labels.
